title: River Walk traffic: two riders with pedal loops, two lane riders, two cars
note: Your redraw calls on the road cars and cyclists (25 Oct). Made at true scale from a blockout with Pepper at 1x, on SpriteCook's own pixel grid (no resizing anywhere), snapped to the River Walk palette, then fixed by hand after an independent review (every changed pixel in art/source/<name>/edits.json). One ink for the family, the bench's black; one wheel drawn once and stamped twice; faces with a nose, mouth and clear eye. The promenade riders are 1.85 m at Pepper's scale (87 px) with a pedal loop that turns once a second. The road's bike lane is nearer than the promenade (55 px a metre, like the cars), so its riders are their own pictures at that size; only their top half shows above the screen edge. SpriteCook 220 credits.
question: The cars came out a little bigger than my guess (estate 241 x 88 px, hatchback 185 x 77): both are still at or under real car size. Keep? The road's other three cars (taxi, van, car 5) are the old art: redraw them in the same style next?
